script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: A New Path

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

ANNE, 45, a dedicated architect, stands at her kitchen counter. She lovingly
pours coffee into two mugs and sets them on the table. She looks up and
smiles as her HUSBAND, MIKE, 48, enters from the living room.

ANNE
Morning, dear. Ready for another day of work?

MIKE
(chuckles)
Always. But not today. Today's my last day.

ANNE
(startled)
Last day? As what?

MIKE
(sighs)
From the IT department. I've been offered an amazing opportunity in marketing.
It's time for a change.

INT. ANNE'S STUDIO - DAY

Anne sits at her drafting table, staring at her latest design plans. Her
mind races with thoughts of Mike's career change.

ANNE
(to herself)
What about us? Our careers have always been in sync. How will this affect us?

INT. ANNE'S OFFICE - DAY

Anne meets with her BOSS, JESS, 50, an accomplished architect. They discuss
Anne's recent designs and her concerns about Mike's career change.

JESS
Anne, you're an excellent architect. And if you want to grow, you can't let
your personal life dictate your professional decisions.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Anne and Mike sit across from each other, sipping their coffees. They share
their thoughts and fears about the future.

MIKE
I know this is a big change, but it's for the best. And we'll figure it out
together.

ANNE
I want to support you, but I'm worried about us. What if your new career
keeps you away from home more?

MIKE
We'll make it work. We always have.

INT. ANNE'S STUDIO - DAY

Anne puts pen to paper, sketching out new designs for a community center. She
feels inspired and energized, realizing that her career doesn't have to be
limited by Mike's.

INT. MARKETING FIRM - DAY

Mike starts his new job in marketing. He enters his office, filled with
excitement and nervousness.

INT. ANNE'S OFFICE - DAY

Anne presents her latest design to her colleagues, including MIKE, who is
impressed and proud of his wife's work.

MIKE
Anne, this is incredible. I knew you could do it.

ANNE
Thank you, Mike. I couldn't have done it without your support.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Anne and Mike share a meal together, both reflecting on their new careers
and the strength of their bond.

ANNE
(smiling)
I'm so proud of you, dear. And I'm excited for this new chapter in our lives.

MIKE
(grinning)
Me too, Anne. Me too.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
